analysis: Previous round produced 4 promoted candidates (screen_effect 0.0039-0.0050) but none survived full validation (effects -0.0009 to -0.0029). The strongest screen signals combined (i) momentum/trend slope from [29,95] with (ii) volume/order-flow statistics from [95,158] and (iii) short-horizon KBar morphology from [0,9]. Screened-out candidates reveal that pure single-operator primitives (vol_price_corr, path_efficiency, tail_asymmetry) and overly short windows (4-6) underperformed, while window 10-20 channels with cross-slice interactions (ratio/product/diff) dominated. Strategy for Round 1: (a) reweight toward cross-slice ratio/product interactions that link [29,95] trend with [95,158] volume; (b) use mid-length windows 10-20 to avoid noise; (c) build composites mixing a trend/momentum mechanism, a volume-imbalance mechanism, and a volatility-regime mechanism; (d) explicitly evolve parents cand_a9e1a3f704a1c088 (ema_diff trend) and cand_730c1c3356d36068 (slope/ratio) by refining window scales and adding lead_lag_corr / beta interactions across the price-volume boundary.

You are an autonomous Quantitative Financial AI Scientist in PredicateLab (TSIL domain).
Your objective is to construct mathematically rigorous relational predicates P(X) for the LUSI (Learning Using Statistical Invariants) loss on the CSI300 daily Alpha158 stock panel:
    L(y, y_hat) = tau_hat * ||y - y_hat||_I^2 + tau * (y - y_hat)^T P(X) (y - y_hat)
where batch_x has shape [B, T=20, F=158], phi(X) in R^(B x d) is standardized per column and normalized to unit Frobenius norm, and P(X) = phi_hat(X) @ phi_hat(X)^T.

CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC & MATHEMATICAL CONSTRAINTS:
1. Non-Collapse / High Effective Rank Gate:
   Every candidate is tested on a real CSI300 batch before training. If participation-ratio effective rank r_eff(P) = (tr(P))^2 / ||P||_F^2 < 1.25 or off-diagonal cosine alignment with 11^T/B > 0.98, the kernel collapses to the trivial global shrinkage control (`control:ones`) and is REJECTED.
   Therefore, design descriptors with d >= 3 diverse, weakly correlated dimensions!
2. Beat Both MSE Baseline and `control:ones`:
   A candidate is only validated if paired Delta_IC > min_effect, its 95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, AND it outperforms `control:ones`.
3. Alpha158 Feature Subspace Map (feature_dim=158, valid slice [start, end] with 0 <= start < end <= 158 and end - start >= 2):
